objections.claim: E6 remains gameable despite randomized repetitions. It requires neither a minimum mutation-domain cardinality nor minimum entropy per record, so a registry kind with one eligible site/value produces the same negative artifact in all 12 repetitions and an oracle hardcoded to that artifact passes. The trusted-negative-fixture fallback is necessarily fixed and has the same defect: an oracle can reject only that fixture's digest while accepting every other semantic violation. Therefore the mechanism does not establish discrimination for every NORMATIVE oracle. Require unpredictable families with enforced entropy/cardinality or an independent reference validator, and regressions for singleton-domain and fixture-digest-special-casing oracles.
